name: Touhou Little Maid: Orihime
description:
东方小女仆（Touhou Little Maid: Orihime）的非官方 Fabric 移植，目标 Minecraft 26.3。
上游为 NeoForge 版本，本移植只保留「官方移植会做」的内容：依赖第三方模组才能生效的联动已基本移除（Aquaculture 2、Embeddium/Oculus、Farmer's Delight、Kaleidoscope Cookery、Superb Warfare、Immersive Melodies、PatPat、Ponder、Sophisticated/Traveler's Backpack、Simple Hats、SlashBlade、JMC 等），仅保留 JEI、Jade、Sodium、Iris、Patchouli、Cloth Config、Curios、IPN、Extra Container 的联动。
与原作者及团队无关；不保证与上游存档完全兼容。

An unofficial Fabric port of Touhou Little Maid: Orihime for Minecraft 26.3.
Only the parts an official port would ship are kept: integrations that require third-party mods have been pruned (Aquaculture 2, Embeddium/Oculus, Farmer's Delight, Kaleidoscope Cookery, Superb Warfare, Immersive Melodies, PatPat, Ponder, Sophisticated/Traveler's Backpack, Simple Hats, SlashBlade, JMC, ...), while JEI, Jade, Sodium, Iris, Patchouli, Cloth Config, Curios, IPN and Extra Container hooks remain.
Not affiliated with the original authors; save compatibility with upstream builds is not guaranteed.
